control_profile: Causal bull-or-eighty-percent-BTC-volatility short suppression plus a symmetric twenty-percent volatility target; stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes, time stops, and turnover clipping are disabled.
falsifier: Reject the local formation neighborhood if shortening funding standardization to thirty-six events loses positive doubled-cost breadth or destroys the center's turnover and gross-edge improvement.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against thirty-six prior events, with three completed price-confirmation bars and causal sixty-day direction plus thirty-day BTC volatility state
hypothesis: The causal regime-side result should survive a modestly faster thirty-six-event funding reference if it reflects crowding unwind rather than a lookback-specific ranking accident.
rebalance_horizon: daily cohorts with three-day confirmed-unwind and seven-day chop-extreme shadow portfolios
